name: openinfer
description: The OpenInfer website and its server, with simulated inference devices

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix web ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix simulator ci --ignore-scripts
scripts.demo: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env server/dist/demo.js
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix simulator run typecheck && npm --prefix simulator test && npm --prefix web test
